description: This file defines a Kubernetes client informer for EndpointSlice resources in the discovery.k8s.io/v1 API group. It includes functions to create shared informers with optional filtering and configuration, and provides interfaces and implementations for accessing EndpointSlice informers and listers.

classes.name: EndpointSliceInformer
classes.description: Interface providing access to a shared informer and lister for EndpointSlice resources.

methods.description: Creates a new shared informer for EndpointSlice resources with filtering options.

methods.description: Creates a new shared informer for EndpointSlice resources with additional configuration options.
